Input to changelog_projeksjon.py, not an edit of its output: the sha stays
the provenance and the projection stays reproducible (CI regenerates and
compares). A subject the Norwegian stopword list can see, and that no entry
here covers, is refused by the generator instead of being projected.
The gate's stopword list is a weak proxy: measured 2026-09-18, three of the
four subjects below score 0 hits and would have reached the public page as
Norwegian. That is why the English form is declared for all three, and why
a landed subject cannot be amended (a squash/merge already happened).

projection time; here the English form is declared once, keyed by sha, so
